convention: Shipped payload lines = git-tracked files under uxr-plugin/ with suffix .py, .md, .yaml, or .yml, excluding uxr-plugin/tests/**; a line ends at \n and a non-empty file without a trailing newline counts one final line (git numstat counting). The loc-account.py 'R1 shipped EX-tests' convention applied as an absolute snapshot of the tree instead of a diff. Per-dir lines group by the first path segment below uxr-plugin/; root-level files group under 'root'.
golden_path_declared_in: uxr-plugin/CHANGELOG.md [0.2.0]: 'the golden path across the workflow now spends six model calls'; per-command shares are declared in uxr-plugin/commands/*.md
